description: This line plot illustrates the average performance, measured in percentage, of three metrics—Precision, Recall, and F1-score—across a range of model sizes, from 70 million to 7 billion parameters, with the x-axis labeled “Model Size (log scale)” indicating a logarithmic scale. The x-axis spans from 70m to 7.0B, with tick marks at regular intervals: 70m, 160m, 410m, 1.0B, 1.4B, 2.8B, and 7.0B. The y-axis is labeled “Avg. Performance (%)” and ranges from 0 to 80, with tick marks at intervals of 20. The red line, marked with triangles, represents Precision, starting at approximately 78% at 70m and ending at approximately 78% at 7.0B, showing a slight dip around 410m to about 70% before recovering. The blue line, marked with triangles, represents Recall, beginning at approximately 10% at 70m and rising steadily to approximately 45% at 7.0B. The purple line, marked with triangles, represents F1-score, starting at approximately 16% at 70m and increasing steadily to approximately 58% at 7.0B.
